## **Bugs et stabilité** {#theme-bugs_stability}

<!--ir-theme:bugs_stability-->
   **Bugs et stabilité.**
      4 avis récents mentionnent bugs et stabilité.
      Fenêtre d'avis : 18 févr. 2026 - 7 oct. 2026
      **Pourquoi c'est important:** Les utilisateurs mentionnent des crashes ou de l'instabilité. À traiter comme actionnable seulement en cas de pic ou après une mise à jour ; sinon souvent du bruit de baseline.

         **Exemples d'avis:**
            1. _Kaitlyn V_, 7 oct. 2026, 2/5: "Used to love it, super glitchy now. Content is great but tech support is useless, even for paid memberships. Maybe because of all of their layoffs? Peloton doesn't care about their customers, obviously."
            2. _Janki Bhatt_, 16 sept. 2026, 2/5: "Strive score doesn't sync on Pixel Watch 3 due to heart rate loading and sync issue"
            3. _Ashley M_, 14 sept. 2026, 2/5: "Crashes in backgroud when doing "just lift/walk/run" etc. If my phone goes off of the Peloton screen (for ex. to check a msg or check map), it freezes and closes out my workout in progress. Never used to do this. Really frustrating!"
<!--/ir-theme-->
